title: PROMPT
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite 6; dist/index.html exists
checks.cursor_scrubbing: passed: both directions and center dead zone
checks.touch_playback: passed: autoplay, alternating videos, resume after scrolling back
checks.scroll_phases: passed: panel rise, gallery transforms, white outro, view pill and footer
checks.assets: passed: two decoded videos, ten images, locally bundled Inter Tight 500

notes: Ready for management-session review; not deployed or pushed.
